points.title: 童年与少年时代
points.description: 康德出生于东普鲁士的柯尼斯堡（今俄罗斯加里宁格勒），是一个马鞍制造家庭的八个孩子之一。他的家庭属于虔诚的虔敬派，这种宗教背景影响了他的早期教育。康德在柯尼斯堡的腓特烈学院接受基础教育，表现出非凡的智力。1737年，他进入柯尼斯堡大学，开始学习哲学和自然科学。这段时期，他广泛阅读了牛顿、莱布尼茨和沃尔夫等人的著作，为后来的哲学体系奠定了基础。柯尼斯堡的严格教育环境和宗教氛围塑造了他早期的思想倾向。
points.descriptionEn: Kant was born in Königsberg, East Prussia (now Kaliningrad, Russia), into a family of saddle makers with eight children. His family belonged to the Pietist movement, which influenced his early education. Kant received his basic education at the Friedrichskollegium in Königsberg and showed exceptional intellectual abilities. In 1737, he entered the University of Königsberg, beginning his studies in philosophy and natural sciences. During this period, he extensively read works by Newton, Leibniz, and Wolff, laying the foundation for his later philosophical system. The rigorous educational environment and religious atmosphere of Königsberg shaped his early intellectual tendencies.

points.title: 大学学习与早期学术生涯
points.titleEn: University Studies and Early Academic Career
points.description: 1740年，康德开始在柯尼斯堡大学学习，最初专注于数学和自然科学。1746年，由于父亲去世，他不得不中断学业，担任家庭教师长达九年之久，先后在东普鲁士的多处乡村担任教师。这段经历使他有机会接触不同社会阶层，丰富了他的人生阅历。1755年，康德重返柯尼斯堡大学，以论文《论火》获得硕士学位，并开始担任讲师。他教授的课程极为广泛，包括物理学、数学、地理学、人类学、逻辑学和哲学等多个领域。这一时期，他开始发表关于自然哲学的论文，逐渐形成了自己的思想体系。
points.descriptionEn: In 1740, Kant began studying at the University of Königsberg, initially focusing on mathematics and natural sciences. In 1746, due to his father's death, he had to interrupt his studies and worked as a private tutor for nine years in various rural areas of East Prussia. This experience allowed him to contact different social classes and enriched his life experience. In 1755, Kant returned to the University of Königsberg, obtained his master's degree with the thesis 'On Fire,' and began working as a lecturer. His teaching covered a wide range of subjects, including physics, mathematics, geography, anthropology, logic, and philosophy. During this period, he began publishing papers on natural philosophy, gradually forming his own philosophical system.

points.title: 讲师时期与思想转型
points.description: 作为柯尼斯堡大学的讲师，康德教授的课程极为广泛，从自然科学到人文科学无所不包。1766年，他担任柯尼斯堡皇家图书馆副馆长，这一职位使他能够接触到大量学术文献。这一时期，康德的思想经历了重要转变，从早期的莱布尼茨-沃尔夫理性主义转向对经验主义的关注。他发表了多篇重要论文，包括《论空间与时间的形而上学基础》(1768)和《论负数概念》(1763)等。1770年，康德以论文《论感性世界与知性世界的形式与原则》获得教授职位，标志着他'批判时期'的开始，为后来的批判哲学奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: As a lecturer at the University of Königsberg, Kant taught an extremely wide range of courses, covering everything from natural sciences to humanities. In 1766, he became the assistant librarian at the Royal Library of Königsberg, a position that gave him access to a vast amount of academic literature. During this period, Kant's thinking underwent an important transformation, shifting from early Leibniz-Wolff rationalism to a focus on empiricism. He published several important papers, including 'On the Metaphysical Foundations of Space and Time' (1768) and 'On the Negative Magnitudes' (1763). In 1770, Kant obtained a professorship with his dissertation 'On the Form and Principles of the Sensible and Intelligible World,' marking the beginning of his 'critical period' and laying the foundation for his later critical philosophy.

points.title: 批判哲学的创立
points.description: 1770年成为逻辑形而上学教授后，康德进入了创作最旺盛的时期。1781年，他出版了划时代的著作《纯粹理性批判》，提出了著名的'哥白尼式革命'，认为不是我们的认识符合对象，而是对象符合我们的认识能力。1783年发表《未来形而上学导论》，1785年出版《道德形而上学基础》，1787年出版《纯粹理性批判》第二版，1788年发表《实践理性批判》，1790年完成《判断力批判》。这一系列著作构成了康德批判哲学的完整体系，涵盖了认识论、伦理学和美学等领域。康德的生活极为规律，每天下午准时散步，以至于柯尼斯堡的居民可以根据他的散步时间来校对时钟。这种规律性也反映在他的哲学思想中，强调秩序、理性和自律。
points.descriptionEn: After becoming professor of logic and metaphysics in 1770, Kant entered his most productive creative period. In 1781, he published the groundbreaking work 'Critique of Pure Reason,' proposing the famous 'Copernican Revolution,' arguing that it is not our knowledge that conforms to objects, but objects that conform to our cognitive abilities. In 1783, he published 'Prolegomena to Any Future Metaphysics,' in 1785 'Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals,' in 1787 the second edition of 'Critique of Pure Reason,' in 1788 'Critique of Practical Reason,' and in 1790 'Critique of Judgment.' This series of works constitutes Kant's complete critical philosophy system, covering epistemology, ethics, and aesthetics. Kant's life was extremely regular, with his daily afternoon walks being so punctual that the residents of Königsberg could set their clocks by him. This regularity is also reflected in his philosophical thought, emphasizing order, reason, and self-discipline.

points.title: 晚年与思想影响
points.description: 康德的晚年继续发表重要著作，包括1797年的《道德形而上学》和1798年的《学科之争》。1794年，他因宗教观点受到普鲁士政府警告，但未受到严厉惩罚。康德终身未婚，生活简朴，将全部精力投入到学术研究中。他的思想对后世产生了深远影响，直接启发了德国唯心主义的发展，特别是费希特、谢林和黑格尔的哲学体系。康德于1804年2月12日在柯尼斯堡逝世，享年79岁。他的葬礼吸引了大量市民参加，人们为这位'柯尼斯堡的智者'送行。康德的哲学思想不仅改变了哲学的发展方向，也对现代科学、伦理学、政治理论和美学等领域产生了持久影响，成为西方思想史上最重要的哲学家之一。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Kant continued to publish important works, including 'The Metaphysics of Morals' in 1797 and 'The Conflict of the Faculties' in 1798. In 1794, he received a warning from the Prussian government due to his religious views, but was not severely punished. Kant never married and lived a simple life, dedicating all his energy to academic research. His thoughts had a profound influence on later generations, directly inspiring the development of German idealism, especially the philosophical systems of Fichte, Schelling, and Hegel. Kant died on February 12, 1804, in Königsberg at the age of 79. His funeral attracted a large number of citizens who came to pay their respects to this 'sage of Königsberg.' Kant's philosophical thought not only changed the direction of philosophical development but also had a lasting impact on modern science, ethics, political theory, aesthetics, and other fields, making him one of the most important philosophers in the history of Western thought.

supporter.zh: 康德被誉为现代哲学的奠基人，他的批判哲学体系彻底改变了西方哲学的发展方向。支持者认为，康德通过调和理性主义与经验主义，为人类知识建立了坚实的理论基础。他的道德哲学强调人的自律和尊严，为现代伦理学奠定了基础。康德的思想不仅具有理论深度，还具有实践意义，他的'人是目的而非手段'的原则成为现代人权理论的重要源泉。康德对启蒙运动的贡献不可忽视，他提出的'敢于运用你自己的理智'成为启蒙精神的经典表达。
supporter.en: Kant is hailed as the founder of modern philosophy, and his critical philosophy system fundamentally changed the direction of Western philosophical development. Supporters believe that by reconciling rationalism and empiricism, Kant established a solid theoretical foundation for human knowledge. His moral philosophy emphasizes human autonomy and dignity, laying the foundation for modern ethics. Kant's thought not only has theoretical depth but also practical significance, and his principle that 'man is an end in himself, not merely a means' has become an important source of modern human rights theory. Kant's contribution to the Enlightenment is undeniable, and his call to 'dare to know' has become a classic expression of the Enlightenment spirit.

critic.zh: 批评者指出康德的哲学体系存在内在矛盾，特别是在先验唯心论与经验现实之间的张力。他的道德哲学被批评为过于形式化和抽象，缺乏对具体道德情境的考量。康德对理性的过度强调也受到质疑，被认为忽视了情感和直觉在人类道德判断中的重要性。此外，康德的政治哲学被认为过于保守，他对法国大革命的态度从支持转为谨慎，显示出其思想的局限性。一些后现代主义者批评康德的普遍主义立场，认为其试图建立普适性真理的努力忽视了文化和历史的多样性。
critic.en: Critics point out that Kant's philosophical system contains internal contradictions, especially the tension between transcendental idealism and empirical reality. His moral philosophy is criticized as being too formal and abstract, lacking consideration of specific moral situations. Kant's overemphasis on reason has also been questioned, as it is believed to neglect the importance of emotion and intuition in human moral judgment. Additionally, Kant's political philosophy is considered too conservative, as his attitude toward the French Revolution shifted from supportive to cautious, revealing the limitations of his thought. Some postmodern critics attack Kant's universalist position, arguing that his attempt to establish universal truths neglects cultural and historical diversity.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，康德被定位为西方思想史上的转折点人物。他的批判哲学标志着哲学从本体论向认识论的转向，开创了德国古典哲学的先河。康德的'三大批判'体系成为现代哲学教育的核心内容，影响了几代哲学家。在流行文化中，康德常被描绘为典型的'教授形象'——生活规律、思想深邃、言辞严谨。他的肖像和名言经常出现在哲学相关的书籍、电影和艺术作品中。康德的思想超越了单纯的学术领域，对现代科学方法论、法律理论、政治哲学和美学产生了深远影响，成为西方文明的重要思想遗产。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Kant is positioned as a pivotal figure in the history of Western thought. His critical philosophy marks the shift of philosophy from ontology to epistemology, pioneering German classical philosophy. Kant's 'three critiques' system has become the core of modern philosophical education, influencing generations of philosophers. In popular culture, Kant is often depicted as the typical 'professor figure'—regular in life, profound in thought, and precise in speech. His portraits and quotes frequently appear in philosophy-related books, films, and artworks. Kant's thought transcends purely academic domains, having a profound impact on modern scientific methodology, legal theory, political philosophy, and aesthetics, becoming an important intellectual legacy of Western civilization.

self.zh: 有两种东西，我对它们的思考越是深沉和持久，它们在我心灵中唤起的惊奇和敬畏就会日新月异，不断增长，这就是我头上的星空和心中的道德律。
self.en: Two things fill the mind with ever new and increasing admiration and awe, the more often and steadily we reflect upon them: the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me.

others.zh: 康德是第一个真正批判性的哲学家，也是最后一个体系构建者。他摧毁了旧的形而上学，却为未来的形而上学奠定了基础。
others.en: Kant was the first truly critical philosopher and the last system-builder. He destroyed the old metaphysics yet laid the foundation for future metaphysics.
